facts.anchor: You can put money on this next one, kemosabe. I got it straight from the horse’s mouth.

facts.fact: CIA 需要发言人的理由，是替该机构误导国会，把深层政府的失败粉饰成成功。
facts.anchor: The reason CIA needs a spokesman is to help the Agency mislead Congress, by spinning her deep-state failures into successes.

facts.fact: 发言人工作的定义是知道真相然后说相反的话，年薪 58 万美元。
facts.anchor: it is to know the truth, then say the opposite. Pretty easy work for $580,000 per annum

facts.fact: 全世界秘密情报机构里只有 CIA 有发言人。
facts.anchor: nobody but CIA has a spokesman. Nobody.

facts.fact: CIA 忘记 compartmentation 一词含义的准确日期是 1996 年 12 月 17 日星期二。
即将离任的中情局局长约翰·多伊奇（比利时布鲁塞尔人）多年违反 compartmentation 的基本原则。
facts.anchor: outgoing CIA Director John Deutch of Brussels, Belgium, had been violating some of the most basic tenets of compartmentation

facts.fact: 多伊奇把大量绝密文件存在苹果台式电脑的记忆卡上，电脑放在他七楼的 CIA 办公室。
facts.anchor: It seems Deutch had compiled this huge stash of TOP SECRET documents on memory cards attached to an Apple desktop computer in his CIA office up there on the Seventh Floor.

facts.fact: 多伊奇最终获得总统特赦，赦免他可能做过的一切可疑之事。
facts.anchor: Deutch got a presidential pardon to forgive anything at all hinky he might or might not ever have done
